jobs.title: Market Research Field Interviewer Car Required Part-time (Wakefield)
jobs.description:
Job Description

A Day in the Life of an Ipsos Field Market Research Interviewer

Imagine this:

It’s a sunny Wednesday afternoon. You’ve had a great day, and now it’s time to embark on your shift as a Field Market Research Interviewer! You’re set for a scheduled 6-hour shift, starting around 1 or 2 PM, one of three you’ve pre-booked for the week, which can include weekdays and weekends between 9 AM and 8 PM.

You hop into your car—don’t forget your business insurance and valid driver’s license! Your mission? To engage with people right at their doorsteps, gathering their opinions and experiences. You’ll be going door-to-door, inviting them to participate in surveys. But don’t worry; we provide all the training you need to feel confident approaching people, even if they weren’t expecting a visit. Plus, we offer mileage reimbursement for your travels!

Equipped with a company-provided tablet, you’ll record their answers—no paperwork required! And the best part? You’re making a real difference! The insights you gather help businesses and organizations make decisions that positively impact your community.

What Makes Ipsos Special?
  • Diversity and Inclusion: We’re proud to be recognized by The Times as one of the top 50 companies for gender balance in the UK for two consecutive years!
  • Award-Winning Training: We set you up for success with comprehensive training programs.
  • Social Responsibility: Our BELONG networks foster a welcoming and inclusive environment for everyone.
  • Commitment to Sustainability: We strive to minimize our environmental footprint and promote ESG principles.

As an Ipsos interviewer, you’ll also enjoy access to:

  • Ipsos More: A fantastic platform offering discounts on everything from clothing and holidays to household goods and everyday essentials. Treat yourself while saving money!
  • Ipsos Wellbeing: A dedicated resource to support your wellbeing, with tips and advice on staying active, eating well, and practicing mindfulness.
This Job Might Be for You If:
  • You love meeting new people and hearing their stories.
  • You’re comfortable striking up conversations and putting people at ease, even in unexpected situations.
  • You’re looking for a part-time gig that lets you choose your hours (at least 12 hours per week in pre-booked 6-hour shifts) and be your own boss.
  • You’re passionate about your community and want to have a voice in shaping its future.

Sound like a good fit? Apply now and join our team of Market Research Interviewers!
